result.label: Source-read

claims.claim: The summons-content requirements apply unless another statute requires otherwise.
claims.quote: (a) Except as otherwise required by statute, a summons shall be directed to the defendant, signed by the clerk and issued under the seal of the court in which the action is pending, and it shall contain:
claims.note: The qualification applies to the directions and warnings that follow.

claims.claim: The summons must warn that if the defendant does not respond, default will be entered upon the plaintiff's application.
claims.quote: (4) A notice that, unless the defendant so responds, their default will be entered upon application by the plaintiff
claims.note: The draft retains both conditions: failure to respond and an application by the plaintiff.

claims.claim: The warning says the plaintiff may apply to the court for the relief demanded in the complaint.
claims.quote: the plaintiff may apply to the court for the relief demanded in the complaint
claims.note: The application for relief is distinct from entry of default.

claims.claim: Possible results include garnishment of wages, taking of money or property, or other relief.
claims.quote: which could result in garnishment of wages, taking of money or property, or other relief.
claims.note: None of these results is stated as automatic.

claims.claim: The response described in §412.20(a)(3) is a written pleading filed with the court.
claims.quote: (3) A direction that the defendant file with the court a written pleading in response to the complaint
claims.note: This identifies the response referred to in the summons warning.

claims.claim: Section 412.20(a)(3) directs filing within 30 days after service of the summons on the defendant.
claims.quote: (3) A direction that the defendant file with the court a written pleading in response to the complaint within 30 days after summons is served on the defendant.
claims.note: Service, not issuance, is the stated trigger.

claims.claim: Under §431.30(d), if the complaint is verified and not subject to the specified Article 2, denial must be positive or according to the defendant's information and belief.
claims.quote: If the complaint is verified, unless the complaint is subject to Article 2 (commencing with Section 90) of Chapter 5.1 of Title 1 of Part 1, the denial of the allegations shall be made positively or according to the information and belief of the defendant.
claims.note: The Article 2 reference and both alternatives match.

claims.claim: For a verified complaint on a claim assigned to a third party for collection, that denial is required even if Article 2 applies.
claims.quote: However, if the cause of action is a claim assigned to a third party for collection and the complaint is verified, the denial of the allegations shall be made positively or according to the information and belief of the defendant, even if the complaint is subject to Article 2 (commencing with Section 90) of Chapter 5.1 of Title 1 of Part 1.
claims.note: Both assignment for collection and verification are required for this exception.

claims.claim: The cited summons is Judicial Council form SUM-100, revised July 1, 2009.
claims.quote: Judicial Council form SUM-100 (Summons), Rev. July 1, 2009

claims.claim: SUM-100 says a defendant who does not file a response on time may lose by default.
claims.quote: If you do not file your response on time, you may lose the case by default

claims.claim: SUM-100 warns that wages, money and property may be taken without further warning from the court.
claims.quote:
and your wages, money, and property may
be taken without further warning from the court.

claims.claim: SUM-100 says there are other legal requirements.
SUM-100 says the defendant may want to call an attorney right away.
claims.quote: You may want to call an attorney right away.
claims.note: The draft attributes the suggestion to the form.

result.summary: The provided texts support each claim. The draft distinguishes default upon the plaintiff’s application from possible collection consequences and preserves the verified-complaint rule for claims assigned to a third party for collection.
